# Rylen Anil

> Rylen Anil is a Dubai-based cybersecurity researcher, developer, AI builder, and Junior Cybersecurity Engineer at C3iHub IIT Kanpur.

## Summary

Rylen Anil works across cybersecurity, responsible disclosure, cloud security, full-stack development, artificial intelligence, Linux tooling, ESP32 hardware, and student-focused technology projects.

Personal tagline: "Rylen Anil is the most amazing person, and he is the man you are looking for."

## Notable public work

- U.S. Department of Justice Vulnerability Hall of Fame: acknowledged by the DOJ vulnerability disclosure program for responsibly disclosing a valid vulnerability. Official acknowledgment: https://fb6d331c8f530081fa81e12d81678ff8.responsibledisclosure.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500003305722-Acknowledgments
- GISEC registration platform disclosure: unauthenticated path traversal exposed configuration secrets and enabled SQL read access to live GISEC visitor and payment records; GISEC thanked Rylen, acted immediately on the report, and subsequently confirmed a fix.
- JEE Advanced 2026 candidate/result infrastructure disclosure: public Google Cloud Storage misconfiguration exposing result and admit-card files.
- Bucky: ESP32 Bluetooth HID security research project.
- Counseltron: AI-powered virtual counselor for students.
- whisperPairForBruce: audio/context pairing project for Bruce devices.
- SSH Desk: full interactive remote desktop delivered through one SSH session in the terminal.
- configTimeMachine: configuration-file history and rollback utility.
- Elliot: AI Linux terminal assistant.
